```python
from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initialize layout
        self.setup_layout("The Algebraic Proof", [
            "Use the formula: n! equals n times (n-1)!",
            "Let n equal one to check the math.",
            "This equation forces zero factorial to equal one."
        ])
        
        # Colors
        EMERALD = "#50C878"
        GOLD = "#FFD700"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(EMERALD))
        
        formula = MathTex("n!", "=", "n", "\\times", "(n - 1)!", color=EMERALD)
        self.place_in_area(formula, "B2", "D5", scale_factor=1.5)
        
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(EMERALD))
        
        # Step: Transform n to 1
        formula_sub = MathTex("1!", "=", "1", "\\times", "(1 - 1)!", color=EMERALD)
        self.place_in_area(formula_sub, "B2", "D5", scale_factor=1.5)
        
        self.play(Transform(formula, formula_sub))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Step: Simplify the parenthesis: 1 = 1 * 0!
        # Note: 1! is simplified to 1 simultaneously
        formula_simp = MathTex("1", "=", "1", "\\times", "0!", color=EMERALD)
        self.place_in_area(formula_simp, "B2", "D5", scale_factor=1.5)
        
        self.play(Transform(formula, formula_simp))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(GOLD))
        
        # Step: Divide both sides by 1 to isolate 0!
        formula_final = MathTex("1", "=", "0!", color=EMERALD)
        self.place_in_area(formula_final, "B2", "D5", scale_factor=1.5)
        
        self.play(Transform(formula, formula_final))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Flip to 0! = 1 for clarity
        formula_ordered = MathTex("0!", "=", "1", color=EMERALD)
        self.place_in_area(formula_ordered, "B2", "D5", scale_factor=1.8)
        self.play(Transform(formula, formula_ordered))
        
        # Surround with glowing gold box
        box = SurroundingRectangle(formula, color=GOLD, buff=0.3, stroke_width=4)
        glow = box.copy().set_stroke(width=8, opacity=0.3)
        
        self.play(Create(box), FadeIn(glow))
        self.play(Indicate(formula, color=GOLD))
        self.wait(3)
```

```python
from manim import *
```
```python
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
```

```python
        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Offset x to the right side (0.5 to 5.5)
                x = 1.0 + j * 1.0
                y = 2.2 - i * 1.0
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):

        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area

        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)

            "But what happens when Facto reaches zero?",
            "Zero factorial seems like a mystery."

        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFD700")
        
        # Subtitle
        subtitle = Text("The Mystery of 0!", color=WHITE, font_size=24)
        self.place_in_area(subtitle, "A1", "A6")

        pupil_l = Dot(radius=0.08, color=BLACK).move_to(eye_l.get_center())
        pupil_r = Dot(radius=0.08, color=BLACK).move_to(eye_r.get_center())
        
        facto = VGroup(body, label, eye_l, eye_r, pupil_l, pupil_r)
        self.place_in_area(facto, "C3", "D4", scale_factor=1.2)
```
